A_repair.question: How many people did not enjoy the finale episode?
A_repair.evidence: did not enjoy refers to stars = 1; the finale episode refers to episode = 24
A_repair.root_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.person_id) FROM Vote AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.stars = 1 AND T2.episode = 24
A_repair.error_text: Execution error: no such column: T1.person_id
A_repair.gated_final_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.votes) FROM Vote AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.stars = 1 AND T2.episode = 24
A_repair.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.episode = 24 AND T2.stars = 1

B_gate_loses.question: List down the record ID of records released between 2000 to 2003.
B_gate_loses.evidence: record ID refers to game.id; released between 2000 to 2003 refers to release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003
B_gate_loses.root_sql: SELECT T1.game_id FROM game_platform AS T1 WHERE T1.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003
B_gate_loses.error_text: Execution error: no such column: T1.game_id
B_gate_loses.gated_final_sql: SELECT T2.id FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ON T1.game_publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003
fixed_candidates: rev1: SELECT T3.id FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game_publisher AS T2 ... INNER JOIN game AS T3 ON T2.game_id = T3.id WHERE ... (EX 0)
rev2: SELECT T1.id FROM game_platform AS T1 WHERE T1.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003 (EX 1)
B_gate_loses.reference_sql: SELECT T.id FROM game_platform AS T WHERE T.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2003

C_silent_and_reference_conflict.question: What is the difference of 10 stars votes between the first episode and the last episode?
C_silent_and_reference_conflict.evidence: ... the difference = subtract(votes where episode = 1, votes where episode = 24) where stars = 10
C_silent_and_reference_conflict.gated_final_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.episode = 1 THEN T2.votes ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.episode = 24 THEN T2.votes ELSE 0 END) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.stars = 10
C_silent_and_reference_conflict.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.episode = 24 THEN T1.votes ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.episode = 1 THEN T1.votes ELSE 0 END) FROM Vote AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T2.episode_id = T1.episode_id WHERE T1.stars = 10

related.note: reference uses result = 'Nominee' although the evidence says result = 'Winner'; zs, fixed, gated all follow the evidence and score EX 0; gated revision repaired a column error (no such column: T2.role) and returned an empty result

D_interface_defect.question: How many transactions had Frank-Paul Santangelo made in July, 2014?
D_interface_defect.legacy_root_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transaction AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.First = 'Frank-Paul' AND T2.Last = 'Santangelo' AND SUBSTR(T1.TransactionDate, 1, 4) = '2014' AND SUBSTR(T1.TransactionDate, 6, 2) = '07'
D_interface_defect.quoted_root_sql_fragment: ... FROM "transaction" AS T1 ... WHERE T2."First" = 'Frank-Paul' AND T2."Last" = 'Santangelo' ...
